result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential sidewalk in front of row houses, where building steps and a trash can create pinch points for pedestrians. A large SUV is parked parallel to the curb, providing no buffer between the walkway and the roadway while also obstructing sightlines.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The effective width of the sidewalk is significantly reduced by the protruding steps of the row houses, making it difficult for pedestrians to pass each other.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk in front of the houses

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The large parked SUV blocks the view between the sidewalk and the street, which could be hazardous if a pedestrian attempts to cross mid-block.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the sidewalk to provide a clear, unobstructed path that meets accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with trees or planters to create a physical buffer between the narrow sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street lined with row houses that have zero setback from the sidewalk. While a continuous concrete sidewalk is provided, it lacks a protective buffer from the roadway and is currently cluttered with waste containers.
